name: branding-typography-and-glass-infinity-app-icons-on-misty-blue
title: Serif and sans type specimens above two glassy infinity app icons on a blue mountain mist
whatItIs: A blue-to-peach misty landscape with two specimen blocks (Petrona serif and Onest sans, each with pangram and numerals), hex codes, and two rounded-square app icons: a soft yellow, pink and blue infinity loop and a glossy translucent glass infinity on a peach-blue gradient.
whatItMeans: Calm and airy; soft gradients and glass suggest a gentle, limitless product.
techniques: Pair a display serif with a plain sans.
Show two icon treatments (flat gradient and glass).
Use a misty gradient landscape as the page.
Print hex codes in the corners.

vocabulary.definition: An app icon with translucent glossy 3D form.
A sample sentence containing every letter.
